player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Fa wo move sɛ **[macro  micro]** (nkonnwa mmienu 0-8):
• *macro*  = mini-board bɛn na wopɛ sɛ wodi mu
• *micro* = square bɛn na wopɛ sɛ wodi mu mini-board no mu
Nhwehwɛmu `[7 8]` ➜ si wo mark wɔ mini-board 7, square 8, na
hyɛ wo opponent sɛ ɔnko di wɔ mini-board 8 akyi.

Wo ne `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwe no [macro micro] a akontaahyɛde 0-8 wom.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ɛsɛ sɛ emu biara yɛ 0 kosi 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row anaa col no nni mu.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Wɔagye dan no ahyɛ mu dedaw.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔkwampaefo no di agoru wɔ micro board a edi hɔ so.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Wɔadi kan adi ɔfã a wɔato din "micro board" no so nkonim dedaw.

next_board.any: micro board biara a ɛwɔ hɔ

game_action.played: Odwumanyɛni {player_id} adi dwuma wɔ micro board {macro_idx}, afiri {micro_idx} (afiri {row}, afiri {col}). Odwumanyɛni {opponent_id} ɛse hɔ ara na ɛdi dwuma wɔ {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Player {player_id} no na ɔredi nkonim wɔ Ultimate Tic Tac Toe! mu.
